svg.text: GTR70E WYVERN, Pico 2 W perfboard, 20 x 24, 2.54 mm pitch (50 x 70 mm)
100k to PACK+, 47k to GND, 100nF to GND
470 uF bulk (+ to B, - to A)
UBEC 5 V out (+ to B22, - to A22)
Power chain, off-board (everything before column A / column B)
pack- -> UBEC IN- -> UBEC OUT- -> COLUMN A (GND bus). One common ground, no split returns.
The three passives, and what each is for
Servo stall transient reservoir. Without it a stall browns out the Pico.
8.4 V -> 2.686 V | 6.0 V -> 1.918 V both inside the 3.3 V ADC range
Anti-alias / noise filter on the ADC tap. Sits across the 47k leg.
